leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply Ionic components to construct a structured restaurant menu interface
Implement Angular services to manage restaurant menu data retrieval
Use TypeScript interfaces to define the structure of menu item objects
Execute Angular data binding to display menu item properties in the template
Utilize Ionic list components to render a scrollable collection of menu items
Apply array iteration methods to traverse and display each menu item
Implement event handling to respond to user interactions with menu items
Control component styling by applying Ionic CSS utilities to menu elements
Construct a responsive layout that adapts to different screen sizes
Define component properties to store and manage the menu data state
Use Angular lifecycle hooks to initialize menu data when the component loads
Implement conditional rendering to display appropriate content based on data availability
